notes:
**0.13.4**
- **The Pro features page fits again.** With nine features, the list on a Free PC ran past the bottom of the window at 1000 x 680. It now sits in three columns and shows without scrolling.

**0.13.3**
- **Copy text (Alt+X) is now part of A9 Snap Pro.** Window, region and full-screen capture, the strip and the editor stay free. Without Pro, **Alt+X**, **Copy text** in Quick capture and the tray's **OCR capture** open the Pro sheet instead of the picker: nothing is read, nothing is copied and no error shows. Existing free installs are not grandfathered: Pro is a one-time $14.99 purchase with a 14-day money-back guarantee. Copy text on a picture you already took (the strip's right-click menu, the editor's **Copy text** button) stays free.
- **Where it shows.** **Copy text** in Quick capture and the **OCR capture hotkey** row in Settings carry the **PRO** badge without Pro. The **Pro features** page lists it as the ninth feature, with how to use it. The manual (Take a screenshot, Keyboard shortcuts, Settings, Home window, Pro features, Privacy) and the README say so.
- **The capture timing line** now says `pro=yes` or `pro=no` (the cached license state; the Alt+X check never uses the network).

Full release notes: https://github.com/atlas9-ai/a9snap-releases/releases
